In this video, Sanjay Kathuria breaks down the key factors you must consider before buying term insurance in India. From coverage amount, claim settlement ratio, premium affordability, riders, to company trustworthiness — everything is explained in a simple and practical way.

This video is created in partnership with Ditto, India’s most trusted insurance advisory platform. Ditto helps you compare policies, understand the fine print, and choose the right plan for your family’s future — without hidden charges.

✔ How to calculate the right coverage amount for your family
✔ Best features to look for in a term insurance plan
✔ Common mistakes people make while buying insurance

comments.text:
I recently bought HDFC’s Click to Protect term plan because the features looked good, but honestly, the entire experience was exhausting.

The application process starts only after paying the first premium. I was told it would barely take 10 minutes, so I didn’t think much of it. But things went downhill quickly. The sales executive filled in incorrect details, shared the wrong application number and email ID for raising queries, and that alone wasted almost a month.

I had to submit my documents not once or twice, but five times before I even got a confirmation that they were received. The medical scheduling was another struggle the clinic SPOC was rude and took weeks to arrange an appointment. Whenever I requested a weekend slot, there was no response. They would only get back on working days, adding more delays.

I understand that one bad experience doesn’t define a company. But this is term insurance. If buying the policy is this stressful and time consuming, it genuinely makes me wonder what the claims process would be like for our dependents.
